# FeedbackPulse

> FeedbackPulse is employee feedback software for growing teams. It helps HR leaders, founders, and managers run engagement surveys, pulse surveys, performance reviews, and peer reviews in one place, then turn results into trends, reports, and clear next actions. It is built for organizations that want fast setup and actionable feedback without buying a full HRIS.

FeedbackPulse focuses on employee feedback workflows: measuring sentiment, running review cycles, collecting peer input, protecting trust, and helping managers act on results. It is not payroll, benefits, applicant tracking, time-off, or recruiting software.

## Core Product

- [FeedbackPulse Home](https://feedbackpulse.com): Main product overview and positioning for the platform.
- [Engagement Surveys](https://feedbackpulse.com/features/engagement-surveys): Core survey product for pulse surveys, eNPS, lifecycle surveys, AI-assisted insights, reminders, trend analysis, and privacy-conscious feedback collection.
- [Employee Performance Reviews](https://feedbackpulse.com/features/employee-performance-reviews): Structured self-assessments and manager evaluations with reusable templates, flexible cadences, and historical review records.
- [Peer Reviews](https://feedbackpulse.com/features/peer-reviews): 360-degree feedback workflows with structured questions, configurable anonymity, and controlled visibility.
- [Pulse Surveys](https://feedbackpulse.com/help/features/pulse-surveys/): Lightweight recurring surveys for weekly or biweekly sentiment tracking and early warning signals.
- [Analytics & Reports](https://feedbackpulse.com/help/features/analytics/): Aggregated engagement, review completion, team comparisons, exports, and role-based reporting views.
- [Continuous Feedback](https://feedbackpulse.com/help/features/continuous-feedback/): Informal praise and constructive feedback outside formal review cycles.

## Who It Is For

- [For Small Teams](https://feedbackpulse.com/small-teams): Lightweight feedback workflows for teams that want structure without enterprise overhead.
- [For Growing Companies](https://feedbackpulse.com/growing-companies): Reviews, surveys, and analytics designed to scale from early growth through larger headcount.
- [Support Better Team Management](https://feedbackpulse.com/for-team-leads): Manager-focused use cases for better 1-on-1s, visibility into team sentiment, and stronger coaching.
- [Getting Started with FeedbackPulse](https://feedbackpulse.com/help/getting-started/): High-level explanation of organizations, users, managers, teams, surveys, and review cycles.

## Problems FeedbackPulse Solves

- [Quick Setup Guide](https://feedbackpulse.com/help/getting-started/quick-setup/): For teams replacing spreadsheets, generic forms, or slow enterprise rollouts with a faster feedback setup.
- [Invite Your Team](https://feedbackpulse.com/help/getting-started/invite-team/): Explains roles, team setup, reporting lines, and how organizations structure access.
- [Your First Review Cycle](https://feedbackpulse.com/help/getting-started/first-review-cycle/): Shows how to launch a first review or survey cycle without heavy admin work.
- [Employee Pulse Surveys Guide](https://feedbackpulse.com/resources/employee-pulse-surveys-guide): Explains why teams run frequent pulse surveys instead of waiting for annual feedback.
- [Remote Employee Performance Reviews](https://feedbackpulse.com/resources/remote-employee-performance-reviews): Best practices for fair, structured reviews in remote and hybrid teams.
- [Employee Net Promoter Score (eNPS) Guide & Calculator](https://feedbackpulse.com/resources/employee-net-promoter-score-enps-complete-guide-calculator): Reference for measuring employee advocacy and understanding promoter/passive/detractor trends.
- [Employee Turnover Calculator](https://feedbackpulse.com/tools/employee-turnover-calculator): Helps quantify retention problems and connect employee feedback programs to business impact.
- [Team Survey Builder](https://feedbackpulse.com/tools/team-survey-builder): AI-assisted tool for drafting custom survey questions around engagement, challenges, and team goals.
